warnings: Slab details 'ขยายพื้น' (S-13, 1:20). Each slab's reinforcement is a list of layers (bar_layers, spec section 0.6) with the printed callout verbatim; 'ตรง สลับคอม้า' = straight bars alternating with bent-up (cranked) bars, 'เสริมพิเศษ' = extra top bars over the supports, extent printed as 0.2L.
Ø bars -> RB (spec section 6, symbol only); S1 is detailed with DB12 throughout (bathroom slab, 0.15 thick).
'S3-S4-S5 ดูขยายบันได' — S5 is detailed only on the stair sheets; S3 and S4 also appear here.
RS1's two layers are drawn as the top layer of a cantilever slab; their exact face for each callout is read from the leader lines (flag).
